resources.string: Pair with the computer in system settings. Tap Connect, then select this phone on the computer.
Use the same network. Start Wi-Fi reception on the computer, then enter its IP address.
Enter the code only for a new or forgotten computer. Remembered computers connect without a code.
Remembered computers: %1$d · No code needed next time
First connection: enter the code shown on the computer
Paired · No code needed next time
The microphone is used only while connected.
No paired computers yet. Computers appear here after the first connection.
Forgotten computers: %1$d. Other pairings are unchanged.
Unable to save changes. Try again; other devices will be kept.
Pairing records are damaged or cannot be decrypted. Resetting removes all saved computers from this phone. A pairing code will be required next time.
Devices forgotten. Pair again to connect.
Enter six digits, or leave blank for a paired computer
Cannot read pairing records. Open Paired devices to reset them.
Waiting for the computer via Bluetooth…
Unable to start. Check permissions and try while the app is open.
Cannot start recording. Allow microphone access and connect while the app is open.
Device verification failed. Check the connection and try again.
Update the computer app to Windows 0.3.1 or later.
Computer identity verification failed. Check which computer is connected.
First connection to this computer: enter the six-digit pairing code.
Pairing code or device credentials do not match. Pair again.
Computer credentials changed unexpectedly. Pair again.
Cannot save pairing records. Try again.
Too many saved computers. Forget an unused computer first.
Turn on Bluetooth and pair with the computer in system settings.
This phone cannot record at 48 kHz.
Cannot initialize the microphone. Check permissions and other recording apps.
Cannot read microphone audio. Reconnect and try again.
Connection timed out. Check the computer and network, then try again.
Cannot find the computer. Check its IP address.
Connection failed. Check the computer, Bluetooth or Wi-Fi, then try again.
